source_binding.mechanism: cluster-ensemble/consensus-clustering robustness applied as a two-view membership-consensus guard

public_sources.claim_used: Cluster ensembles combine multiple partitionings into a consolidated clustering and were evaluated as a way to improve robustness across different features, objects, or clustering solutions.
Consensus clustering combines multiple clustering results and can improve robustness and stability relative to relying on a single clustering solution.

source_binding.literal_external_runtime_reason: No clustering ensemble implementation, hosted computation, external model, cloud service, or user execution is used. Public sources supply only multi-partition consensus semantics.
source_binding.chat_native_reduction: Freeze materially different Hamming and Jaccard similarity views before evaluation. Require exact agreement on the supported anomaly core U1/U2/U3 before a novel-stratum candidate may proceed. A copied view is not diversity, disagreement blocks activation, and thresholds cannot be tuned after seeing disagreement in the same generation.

scope_limit: Constructed two-view cluster trace only. Agreement of two hand-chosen metrics does not establish independence or immunity to a shared common bias.
unresolved_child: Both similarity views may share the same omitted features. A later leaf should test feature-view diversity or a deliberately orthogonal evidence projection before novel taxonomy activation.

quota_cost_assessment.repository_transport_note: Repository API is lightweight state/evidence transport only; rate-limit interruption is checkpoint/retryable and API volume is not used as compute.
